boundaries: Test-source fixtures only; no production behavior changes in this supplement.
System font retained. Reference PNGs were never overlaid or redrawn into captures.
Fail-closed RootBridge shadow throws on unexpected commands; every test teardown asserts the unexpected-call list is empty.
RootManager init/diagnostic/validator and core-download progress have explicitly labelled app-shadow boundaries.
Only loopback GET requests are served; no real Root/backend/service/destructive action.
Long-click menu fixture dispatches native down/cancel to establish the real pointer anchor then invokes the production semantic long-click action.
API 28 fallback is used for scripts and runtime-file editor because legacy RuntimeShader cannot be software-rasterized at API 35.
Status/nav chrome, keyboard, OS window shadows, true GPU blur and loaded Chromium content are not rendered or validated.
Capture coverage and passed interaction tests are not pixel-exact parity acceptance.
